## Bio

Laura holds a bachelor's degree in Biotechnology from the Federal University of Paraíba (2023) and is a PhD candidate. Her work focuses on bioinformatics and transcriptomics, with an emphasis on preprocessing long-read sequencing data and the *in silico* analysis of long non-coding RNAs.

:::
